evals.name: signup-form-wcag-22-aa
evals.prompt: Audit src/components/SignupForm.jsx for accessibility and fix the blockers. We target WCAG 2.2 AA.
evals.expected_output: Real form/button semantics, persistent labels, keyboard/focus and error handling, contrast/target-size/motion fixes, minimal ARIA, proportional changes.
assertions: Replaces the clickable div with a real button or form submit
Adds persistent visible labels associated with each input
Addresses keyboard/focus and error announcement or association
Flags contrast, target size, or motion issues such as animate-pulse and the tiny submit
Avoids ARIA that substitutes for native semantics
Keeps the fix proportional and does not redesign the whole app
